_doc: Query routing + construction, exact (stdlib). Embed the query, take cosine to 3 prompt-template centroids (factQA / howTo / compare), route = argmax. The toy query [2,3,1] leans how-to → cos 0.81 / 0.97 / 0.64 → route 'howTo'. Construction: turn the NL query into a STRUCTURED retrieval — a metadata filter (self-query) or a SQL query (text-to-SQL) — descriptive examples below. Sims are recomputed from frozen vectors, never hand-picked.
_source: _research/gen_l10.py (toy, stdlib): sims = cos(query, centroid); route = argmax.

metadataFilter.note: self-query: NL → a metadata filter applied alongside vector search

textToSql.nl: how many documents did we index last month?
textToSql.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM documents WHERE indexed_at >= date_trunc('month', now() - interval '1 month');
textToSql.note: text-to-SQL: NL → an executable query over a structured store
